headline: Vibra Energia Reports Strong Third-Quarter Earnings
summary: Vibra Energia, Brazil's largest fuel distributor, posted a net profit of 2.4 billion reais for the third quarter, more than quadrupling its year-ago result. The performance was supported by increased sales volumes and reduced financial expenses.
why: As the largest fuel distributor in Brazil, Vibra's financial health is a key indicator of domestic energy demand and logistics activity in the country.
